description: This Go source file defines a translator module using a 'PiTranslator' struct that manages translation processes with retry logic, placeholder masking, and interaction with a client interface. It includes functions for creating instances, translating text (raw or masked), error handling, and timeout management.

classes.name: PiTranslator
classes.description: A struct responsible for managing translation operations using a client, including retries and placeholder management.

methods.name: NewPiTranslator
methods.description: Creates a new instance of PiTranslator with specified source and target languages, glossary, and thinking level.

methods.name: Translate
methods.description: Performs translation of text with masking, using the associated client.

methods.name: TranslateRaw
methods.description: Performs raw translation of text without masking.

methods.name: translate
methods.description: Internal method that handles the translation process with retries, given a run function.

methods.name: translateWithRetry
methods.description: Attempts to translate with retries on retryable errors, employing delay logic.

methods.name: translateMasked
methods.description: Handles translation with placeholder masking and unmasking.

methods.name: translateRaw
methods.description: Directly interacts with the client to perform a raw translation.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the PiTranslator client's connection if available.

methods.name: runPrompt
methods.description: Executes prompt-based interaction with the client within a timeout context.

methods.name: decoratePromptError
methods.description: Wraps errors from prompting with additional stderr information.

methods.name: normalizeThinking
methods.description: Normalizes the thinking level input to 'low' or 'high'.

methods.name: docsI18nPromptTimeout
methods.description: Reads and parses the environment variable for prompt timeout duration, falling back to default if invalid.
